headline: Forest and Brentford Deadlock at 2-2 as Damsgaard and Domínguez Strike
paragraphs: Nott'm Forest and Brentford are level 2-2 at the City Ground at half-time after a four-goal first half. Chris Wood opened the scoring in the 8th minute, assisted by Ola Aina, from a big chance (xG 0.267) that was the only big chance logged in the period. Brentford responded through Vitaly Janelt (26', xG 0.39, assisted by Mikkel Damsgaard) and then went ahead through Damsgaard (35', xG 0.436, assisted by Christian Nørgaard), the swing that flagged Brentford's momentum. Nicolás Domínguez struck in the 37th minute (xG 0.449, assisted by Elliot Anderson) to restore parity, and the late momentum swing in the 45th minute belonged to Forest. Keane Lewis-Potter was carded for Brentford in the 1st minute.

Forest dominated territory and volume. They led on possession (59% to 41%), field tilt (73 to 27), control (71 to 48) and pass accuracy (84% to 79%), and took 7 shots to Brentford's 3, with 3 on target to 2. Team xG stands at 1.42 for Forest against 0.97 for Brentford. Brentford, by contrast, produced their two goals from just 3 shots, a clinical return that the xG totals suggest was partly fortunate in its timing rather than repeatable volume. Chaos is running at 38 and tempo at 3.2 passes per minute, so the match has been open and transitional.

Data note: the feed's standout-player lines do not reconcile with the event log. Chris Wood is listed with 2 goals and an individual xG of 1.56, yet the log shows one Wood goal and his individual xG exceeds the team total of 1.42. Ola Aina is credited with 2 assists against one logged assist, and his 34 duels won should be verified. These figures have been excluded from the analysis above pending correction. Second-half analysis to follow once the feed is reconciled.
